title: Design version: search opens a collapsed group, N open counts every card
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682435 Ana.
  • {Technician-A} leads exactly three work orders at {Location-A}: {Work-order-1} Approved, {Work-order-2} an Estimate and {Work-order-3} Declined.
    For example: customer ZZAUTOTEST C682435 Design Count.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the arrow on {Technician-A}'s group header to collapse it.
  2. Type the number of {Work-order-1} in "Search".
  3. Look at {Technician-A}'s group.
  4. Clear "Search" and click "Board View".
  5. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1}.
  6. Click "Reassign Lead Tech".
  7. Read the count beside {Technician-A} in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the group collapses.
  • Step 2: only {Work-order-1} matches.
  • Step 3: the group opens and shows {Work-order-1}.
  • Step 4: Board View shows {Technician-A}'s column with three cards.
  • Step 5: the menu opens.
  • Step 6: the dialog opens.
  • Step 7: it reads "3 open": every card in the column is counted.

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: A search that finds work inside a collapsed group: the design shows the group opens to show the matches (Details board, seen when driven); the PRD says the group stays collapsed; its count shows how many match. The N open count in the lead technician dialog: the design shows counts every work order in that technician's column; the PRD says Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review and Complete only. It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D14, D15 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

What the PRD says instead:

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043

  • S2-R16: “When a search or filter finds work orders inside a group the user collapsed, the group stays collapsed; its count shows how many match. Collapsing is the user's saved choice (S2-R13).”
  • S4-R15: “The dialog’s N open count includes Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and Complete work orders.”

Not yet checked against a build.

References from Design

Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html and its flows, driven 14 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026: the source of this case's expected results.

  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, N open: “meta: (this.state.order[t.id] || []).length + " open"”
  • Design — Work Orders Details.dc.html, groups while searching: “// A search or filter opens every group that still has a hit, so results aren't hidden behind a collapsed header.”
  • Design — Work Orders Details.dc.html, open rule: “const open = filtering ? true : !this.state.collapsed[g.id];”
